history.body: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting nearby and starting to look for our first place. Can share a bit more?

Sure! The main Phase 1 layout is Type A: 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Pearl Residences is in established Seberang Jaya, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and Butterworth. Since you’re renting nearby, I’d recommend seeing the layout in person to judge how it might work for everyday living. Would this mainly be for your own stay?
Yes, for ourselves. We’re still comparing a couple of places, but an extra room could be useful. Do you have a general starting price?

A dated package snapshot from 14 August 2026 gives an indicative starting reference of RM301,760, calculated from a RM328,000 base less 8%. It isn’t a confirmed current offer or an all-in price; parking or other applicable components may affect the total, and the exact current unit/package needs confirmation. For your own stay, the third bedroom could give you the extra-room flexibility you mentioned. Seeing the 900 sq ft layout in person would help you judge how it works for everyday living as you compare.

Thanks, that’s useful as a rough reference, though we’d still need to check the current total. The extra room could help since my partner works from home sometimes. Do you have a floor plan we could look at before deciding about a visit?

That makes sense—you can see the layout before deciding on a visit. I don’t have the approved floor-plan image available to send here, so I don’t want to present a description as the actual plan. The project information describes a 900 sq ft, 3-bedroom layout with open-plan living, dining and kitchen areas, a small storage area and no long internal corridor. Since your partner sometimes works from home, the extra bedroom could be useful as a separate work space, though the exact arrangement should be checked against the approved plan. I’ll check whether that plan is available to share with you.

That helps, especially having the shared area open while one room can be used for work. We’d still want to see the approved plan to check whether a desk would fit. Please send it when available, and we can decide from there.
Absolutely—the approved plan is still being checked. I’ll share it once it’s available so you can check whether a desk would fit before deciding about a visit.
